paragraphs: Aptoriki ben Derosai (Dostai; see there), tanna of a baraita. Rabbi Aptorki’s father recited a baraita in connection with Rabbi Chiyya’s first ruling, Bava Metzia 5a. Aptoriki said, Zevachim 12a; Chullin 81a; a separated general-and-particular formulation, Menachot 55b.
